card.name: "Who" after contraindicated in patients
card.fires_on: The word "who" right after "contraindicated in patients", introducing a hypersensitivity clause. Weaker on a few other linking words in animal-study and tumor-risk sentences.

modes.label: Contraindication clause
modes.description: "who" after "is contraindicated in patients", before hypersensitivity wording.
modes.example: HUMALOG is contraindicated in patients<< who>> have had hypersensitivity reactions to insulin lis
